Officer's narrative
Officer narrative, Baytown, Texas. Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane when Driver 2 changed lanes and sideswiped
the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee at the scene and said the knee struck the
lower dash during the impact. The injury is consistent with the direction and force of the collision as I observed the
damage. The damage to Driver 1's vehicle runs along the left rear quarter panel and matches the described contact.
Scene photographs confirm the general positions of both vehicles, but no independent witnesses came forward.
Driver 1 and the Passenger both confirmed that Driver 1 was seated behind the wheel at the time. Among the photos
submitted for the claim, one from an earlier inspection shows a dent in the same location on the left rear quarter
panel. Driver 2 is listed as a named driver on the policy under which the claim was filed. No citations were issued at
the scene. The report is referred for further review.
</page>
